result.reasoning_summary: FW-HARNESS-003 implements deterministic context packet construction and atomic budget controls as specified. The core `build_context_packet()` function enforces that all context material comes only from explicit caller-supplied ContextItem instances, validated against an allowlist of kinds. The packet includes a canonical SHA256 hash of the task record, binding the context to the task's identity. Scope validation ensures relevant_file references exist in task.relevant_files, recent_commit items are valid Git SHAs, and requirement/task_state items match their respective task fields. Architecture constraints and forbidden-change items are mandatory, preventing context construction without explicit bounds. Item and packet byte limits are enforced. The BudgetLedger class implements atomic task/session budget admission: all resource dimensions (model calls, tokens, retries, elapsed time, tool calls, cost) are checked against both task and session limits before any state is mutated; exhaustion triggers a thrown exception without consuming budget. Thread safety uses threading.Lock. All dataclasses are frozen and snapshot returns read-only views, preventing model output from altering audit state. Input validation is comprehensive: empty/duplicate items rejected, malformed identities rejected, unregistered tasks/workers rejected. The 27 test cases cover determinism, hash binding, scope validation, architecture enforcement, byte limits, atomic cross-task admission, exhaustion without consumption, and identity validation. The patch modifies only two new files (harness_context.py and its test module) and updates documentation; no existing code paths are altered. Risk is LOW with no blockers or missing tests.", "Verified: (1) Deterministic context uses canonical JSON with sorted keys, immutable dataclass, SHA256 of payload. (2) Only explicit caller items; ContextItem instances with validated kinds. (3) Task hash bound via task_record_sha256 in payload. (4) Scope: relevant_file checked against task.relevant_files; recent_commit validated as SHA; requirement/task_state match task IDs. (5) Architecture and forbidden_change mandatory. (6) Item byte limits enforced per-item and per-packet. (7) Budget ledger atomic: all checks before mutation, exhaustion raises without consuming. (8) Thread-safe with Lock. (9) Immutable results (frozen dataclasses, MappingProxyType snapshot). (10) Input validation: path traversal blocked, malformed IDs rejected, unregistered tasks rejected. (11) No file reads or model calls. Tests comprehensive and passing."
